g.text: Light Mode Theme Consistency & Title Bar Synchronization
Resolving title bar mismatch (Option 4 Medium Steel Slate #3c4450 across all windows) and unifying Export menu backgrounds with Preferences & Batch processing
BEFORE: Title Bar Mismatch & Dark Navy Export Menu
Pop-up title bar was white/unstyled, and Export menu had hardcoded dark navy #0f172a / #1e293b styling
Radio & TV Segmenter v3.8.6-stable — Project: gun.violence.final.version.rtvs * - Radio & TV Segmenter
Eight years ago, Stanley Crawford lost his son to gun violence...
I love my grandson. I don't want him to end up dead...
AFTER: Option 4 #3c4450 on All Windows + Unified Light Menu
Both top bars match #3c4450, and Export menu adopts clean light surfaces #eaedf0 / #e3e6ea matching Preferences
Radio & TV Segmenter v3.8.6-stable — Project: gun.violence.final.version.rtvs * - Radio & TV Segmenter
Eight years ago, Stanley Crawford lost his son to gun violence...
I love my grandson. I don't want him to end up dead...
Detailed Changes Applied for Complete Light Mode Harmony:
1. Universal Window & Pop-up Title Bar Synchronization (Option 4 Medium Steel Slate):
• Main Application Window and all Modal Dialogs (Export, Preferences, Story Metadata, Voice Match, Shortcuts, ID3 Editor, Batch Processing)
now receive the exact same #3c4450 caption color, crisp white #f8fafc text, and subtle #4e5765 border via Windows DWM attribute propagation.
• Implemented global eventFilter interception on QEvent.Show / WindowActivate to ensure dynamically spawned dialogs never revert to white.
2. Export Menu Theme Normalization (Visual Consistency with Preferences & Batch Processing):
• Refactored CollapsibleSection in prs_shared.py: In Light Mode, section header strips now use clean silver fog #e3e6ea with dark ink #22262c text
and light container backgrounds #eaedf0 instead of hardcoded dark navy #1e293b / rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35).
• Refactored UnifiedExportDialog, WordPress exporter, and YouTube exporter: Buttons, checkboxes, combo boxes, list widgets, and badges
now use light mode token palettes matching Preferences, Batch Processing, and Multi-Stage Processing.
• Refactored Story Metadata Editor, Voice Profile Matcher, and Shortcuts Manager to fully respect active theme mode.
